notes.title: Demo Version Update
notes.notes:
What has been updated in the demo over the past week:
- Added a house that is located between different worlds.
- the ability to customize the house to your taste
- in the worlds you can find details for the home.
- puzzle for opening new worlds can now be assembled
- you can see how many pieces of the puzzle are assembled in different worlds
- Oculus touch users can choose a hand arrangement in the menu that matches the real hands.

Many thanks to everyone who helped me test the demo version on various VR devices.
